definitions.gloss: charm against evil; talisman; protective ward; amulet
definitions.explanation: An object, symbol, or practice believed to protect against evil spirits, bad luck, or misfortune. Encompasses physical objects like talismans and decorations, as well as customs and rituals performed for protection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{魔除|まよ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I placed a protective charm at the entrance.
This stone is said to have protective powers against evil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{柊|ひいらぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鰯|いわし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魔除|まよ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧だ。
examples.english: Decorating with holly and sardine heads at Setsubun is an ancient custom for warding off evil.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{魔|ま}→魔：19358_ma⟧ (demon, evil spirit) + {除|よ}け (warding off, protection). The suffix 〜{除|よ}け is productive and appears in other protective compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魔除|まよ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: evil-warding effect
- {魔除|まよ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧: protective amulet
- {魔除|まよ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧: evil-warding custom
- {魔除|まよ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a protective charm

RELATED WORDS WITH 〜{除|よ}け:
- ⟦{虫除|むしよ}け→虫除け：09715_mushiyoke⟧: insect repellent
- ⟦{日除|ひよ}け→日除け：18418_hiyoke⟧: sunshade, parasol
- {雨除|あまよ}け: rain shelter

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, common {魔除|まよ}け items include {鬼瓦|おにがわら} (demon-faced roof tiles), ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧ (sacred Shinto ropes), and ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧ (mirrors). ⟦{獅子舞|ししまい}→獅子舞：13515_shishimai⟧ (lion dances) performed at festivals also serve as {魔除|まよ}け.
